thread:
jess-support: Heads up — multiple customers seeing increased 502/504s right after the canary flip at ~10:30 UTC. Billing notice: some customers hit unexpected token billing spikes. Error samples show auth failures after a keystore rotation. Request IDs: req_7a2c, req_7a30. Anyone oncall?

taylor-sre: I'm on it. Pulling traces and metrics now. ETA 5. Any deploy id or feature flag changes?

deploy-bot: Deployed canary 'services/inference' v2026.03.17-rc2 at deploy-5259875989 (started ~10:29 UTC).

ryan-eng: We enabled feature flag rotating_keystore=true in the canary at 10:28. Auth service started writing key version=4. Stable still serving key version=3. Likely mismatch where gateway/auth expect v3 but some shards got v4.

maya-ops: Rolling back the canary and toggling the flag now. Starting rollback to stable. CC @oncall-bot for alerts.

oncall-bot: Rollback initiated at 10:36 UTC — reverting services/inference to v2026.03.10 and disabling rotating_keystore for rollout. Will post status updates.

taylor-sre: Quick repro for QA: 
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"ping"}'
```
Observe 502 with gateway body: "upstream auth error: signature invalid" or 504 when upstream timed out.

jess-support: Customer reported ~200 requests, ~35% 5xx over ~6 minutes. Billing ticket INC-7532 attached to the thread. They need a timeline and any credits.

ryan-eng: Logs from auth replicas show: 
```
[10:31:12.437] auth-service ERROR req=req_7a2c "keystore: key not found" version=4 shard=auth-2
[10:31:12.438] auth-service ERROR req=req_7a2c upstream_error="internal key lookup failed"
[10:31:12.439] gateway WARN req=req_7a2c converted=502 reason="upstream auth 500"
```
Looks like some replicas got the new keystore state ahead of others; race during rotation. Gateway maps auth 500 -> 502 to caller.

maya-ops: Hotfix: re-seeded keystore v4 to all auth replicas and restarted auth workers on replicas auth-1..auth-4 (rolling restart). Also temporarily disabled rotating_keystore flag across canary pool.

taylor-sre: Metrics update — 5xx rate dropped from 30% -> 2% within ~4 minutes after hotfix/rollback. Latency back to baseline. Will keep monitoring for another 15m.

jess-support: Thanks. Please annotate timeline and add a short customer-facing blurb. We'll propose a billing credit depending on impact. :thumbsup:

ryan-eng: Follow-ups: add a guard to keystore rotation so new key version isn't accepted until all auth replicas confirm sync, and add a canary-only header to avoid partial reads. I'll open an RFC and a bug ticket.

taylor-sre: Creating incident doc and postmortem draft now. Will include repro steps, logs, and mitigation timeline.

oncall-bot: Incident status: mitigated — monitoring.

jess-support: Closing customer escalation handoff to support for communications. Thanks everyone.
